# CitizenHousing

> CitizenHousing helps users discover verified residential, commercial, and farmhouse properties in India.

## Site
- Home: https://citizenhousing.in/
- Properties: https://citizenhousing.in/properties
- Farmhouse Listings: https://citizenhousing.in/properties/farmhouse
- About: https://citizenhousing.in/about
- Contact: https://citizenhousing.in/Contact

## Core Pages
- Buying Services: https://citizenhousing.in/services/buying
- Selling Services: https://citizenhousing.in/services/selling
- Rental Services: https://citizenhousing.in/services/rental
- Legal Services: https://citizenhousing.in/services/legal
- FAQ: https://citizenhousing.in/faq
- Terms: https://citizenhousing.in/terms
- Privacy Policy: https://citizenhousing.in/PrivacyPolicy

## Crawling Notes
- Use canonical pages and current sitemap: https://citizenhousing.in/sitemap.xml
- Property detail pages are under: https://citizenhousing.in/properties/[slug]
- Farmhouse detail pages are under: https://citizenhousing.in/properties/farmhouse/[slug]
